metadata.description: Live-captured with tools/mock-capture --allow-error-status against UEM 26.2 on 2026-09-24, inside a disposable sdktestrun org group, on an object deleted moments earlier (the org group was deleted afterwards and a second DELETE on it returned 400, quirk 20). Status, errorCode and message are verbatim except that the real resource id (in the path and the message) is replaced by a fixed id chosen to be unique in this corpus; the activityId is the capture anonymizer's output. Second DELETE /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationid} on the same already-deleted macOS app: 400 (not the GET's 401), errorCode 400, 'Application not found or user does not have access to it.'. client.IsNotFound matches the message prefix.

body.message: Application not found or user does not have access to it.
